subtitle: Lesson 8 · Chapter 1: The First Backup Plan

code:
SELECT
    s.session_id, s.login_name, s.host_name,
    s.program_name, s.status,
    s.cpu_time, s.memory_usage
FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions AS s
WHERE s.is_user_process = 1
ORDER BY s.cpu_time DESC;
caption: is_user_process = 1 drops SQL Server's own internal sessions — real activity only.
